meta.name: skill-creator
meta.description: Create and iterate on Agent Skills with proper structure, frontmatter, and progressive disclosure. Make sure to use this skill whenever the user asks to build a new skill, create an agentic instruction, generate a SKILL.md, or automate a workflow into a reusable package, even if they don't explicitly use the word "skill".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把工作流程封装成可复用的智能技能包
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把重复流程变成可复用的智能技能
copy.tagline_en: Turn workflows into reusable agent skills
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to package repeated workflows into reusable agent skills

howto.what: Claude 会先询问用途和边界,再把你的流程整理成一个标准 SKILL.md 文件,包含名称、触发描述和步骤指令,最后保存到指定技能目录。
howto.when: 当你要求构建新技能、生成 SKILL.md,或把某个工作流自动化成复用包时触发,即使你没提“skill”一词也会介入。

say.text: 把我刚刚处理发票的步骤做成一个技能
为每周生成周报的流程写一份 SKILL.md
把这段自动化脚本封装成可复用的技能
say.note: 会确认测试用例和保存位置后再落盘。

howto.what_en: Claude will first ask about your intent and boundaries, then turn the workflow into a standard SKILL.md file with name, trigger description, and step instructions, and save it to the designated skills directory.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to build a new skill, generate a SKILL.md, or package a workflow into a reusable module, even if you don't say the word 'skill'.

say_en.text: Turn the steps I just used to process invoices into a skill.
say_en.note: It will ask about inputs, outputs, and edge cases, then draft a SKILL.md.

say_en.text: Write a SKILL.md for my weekly report workflow.
say_en.note: It will fill in the frontmatter and make the trigger description more specific.

say_en.text: Package this automation script as a reusable skill.
say_en.note: It will confirm test cases and save location before writing.
